Info

Dedicated hotkey binder component for application shortcut key bindings.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.gui.menu.menu_hotkey_binder.MenuHotkeyBinder[source]¶

Bases: object

Binds application-wide keyboard shortcuts to Tkinter root window.

It defines:

methods:
bind_hotkeys - Registers shortcut key combinations to actions.
bind_hotkeys(root: Tk, menu_bar: IAppMenuBar, mutation: IPlanBulkMutator, history: ITrajectoryHistory, table: ITable) → None[source]¶

Binds keyboard shortcuts to window.

Parameters:

  • root – Application root Tk window.

  • menu_bar – IAppMenuBar interface instance.

  • mutation – IPlanBulkMutator domain mutation instance.

  • history – ITrajectoryHistory domain history instance.

  • table – ITable table interface instance.

Exceptions:

None.
